name: gapsuggest-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: gapSuggest (pro) flag gate + a real interaction. Two side tables seeded 0.5 m apart (a 'Narrow' walkway gap) inside the Living/Dining room; the ClearancePanel's 'Nudge apart' button is hidden in Simple and, in Pro, one click widens the gap toward the 0.9 m ideal clearance.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: seed-narrow-gap
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setItems([ { id:'gap-a', defId:'side-table', position:[10.075, 4.1], rotation:0, props:{} }, { id:'gap-b', defId:'side-table', position:[11.025, 4.1], rotation:0, props:{} } ]); })()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: gapSuggest should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-narrow-gap-flagged-simple
steps.failMessage: ClearancePanel should list the narrow gap regardless of gapSuggest

steps.name: assert-no-nudge-button-simple
steps.eval: (() => { const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('#clearancePanel button')]; if (btns.some((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Nudge apart')) throw new Error('Nudge apart button should not render in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: gapSuggest should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: nudge-button-visible
steps.failMessage: 'Nudge apart' button did not appear in Pro mode

steps.name: record-positions-before
steps.eval: window.__before = window.__store.getState().items.map((i) => ({ id: i.id, position: i.position.slice() }))

steps.name: click-nudge-apart
steps.eval: (() => { const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('#clearancePanel button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'Nudge apart'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Nudge apart button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: assert-gap-widened
steps.eval: (() => { const items = window.__store.getState().items; const a = items.find((i) => i.id === 'gap-a'); const b = items.find((i) => i.id === 'gap-b'); const before = window.__before; const ba = before.find((i) => i.id === 'gap-a'); const bb = before.find((i) => i.id === 'gap-b'); const distBefore = Math.hypot(ba.position[0]-bb.position[0], ba.position[1]-bb.position[1]); const distAfter = Math.hypot(a.position[0]-b.position[0], a.position[1]-b.position[1]); if (!(distAfter > distBefore + 0.05)) throw new Error('Nudge apart did not widen the gap: before=' + distBefore + ' after=' + distAfter); return { distBefore, distAfter }; })()
